Service

DME/POS

PMEX offers tailored Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Point of Sale (POS) Billing Services designed to streamline the billing process for medical equipment and supplies. Based in New York, our services encompass every aspect of DME and POS billing, from accurate coding and claim submission to reimbursement management. We ensure that all billing procedures comply with relevant regulations and handle the complexities associated with equipment and supply billing, reducing errors and expediting payment cycles.
